sig: [[["A", "Hi everyone, and welcome to today's webinar, Scaling Cloud Infrastructure on a Budget. I'm Liam Walker, and I'll be your host."], ["A", "We've got just over three hundred people joining from twelve countries, so thanks for being here, wherever you are."], ["A", "Before we dive in, a few housekeeping notes."], ["A", "Everyone's microphone has been muted to keep the background noise down."], ["A", "If you've got a question, please type it into the Q&A box rather than the chat, because the chat moves pretty fast and things get lost."], ["A", "Here's the plan for the next ninety minutes."], ["A", "Our first speaker, Dr. Nina Patel, will talk for about forty minutes on cost monitoring tools."], ["A", "After that, we'll take a ten-minute break, and then our second speaker will walk you through a real migration case study."], ["A", "We'll save the last twenty minutes for your questions."], ["A", "Oh, and I've been asked this already, so I'll say it now: yes, you'll get the slides."], ["A", "A recording and the slide deck will be emailed to all registered attendees within forty-eight hours."], ["A", "Okay, without further ado, let's bring in Nina."]], {"A": "M-AU"}]
